findings.evidence: SturmBound.lean:61-66 and Norm/Trace.lean:322-326 are the same proof; Cusps.lean:148,156 supply both ingredients and Norm/Trace.lean:7 already imports Cusps. This destination is not the one ruled out in the reply on the earlier placement finding: the statement mentions only `𝒢`, not the unbundled `f : F`, so no explicit `𝒢` argument appears at call sites (`Fact` is resolved by instance search). Mathlib's `instance [Γ.IsArithmetic] : Fact (IsCusp ∞ Γ)` (Basic.lean:698) does not apply here — the instance runs IsArithmetic → IsFiniteRelIndex (ArithmeticSubgroups.lean:133), not the converse.

Both sites then do `have : Fact (IsCusp ∞ 𝒢) := ⟨Subgroup.isCusp_infty⟩` and `ModularFormClass.bdd_at_infty f`, and the private helper disappears.
findings.issue: `isBoundedAtImInfty_of_finiteRelIndex` uses only `integerCuspWidth_pos` / `integerCuspWidth_mem_strictPeriods` / `isCusp_of_mem_strictPeriods` — no SturmBound theory — and the same derivation is re-inlined by this PR at Norm/Trace.lean:322-326 (`hf_bdd`). Broadly useful material stranded privately in the terminal file, rederived upstream.

summary: The order identity is in the right home (Norm/Trace.lean, under the decomposition it elaborates) and no import is unused or over-broad. But the "∞ is a cusp of 𝒢, hence f is bounded at ∞" step, which depends on nothing later than Cusps.lean, is now duplicated in two files instead of living there.
